title: Gideon and the Harbor
author: Dominic Lockridge
blurb: Kestrel Kavanagh, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
